scientific_role: C4 evidence bridge only: test whether already-demonstrated SkillRL control-plane representation sensitivity propagates to final ALFWorld success under a fixed policy. This exact-clone experiment is not the paper novelty and cannot establish SQC superiority or partial-overlap dynamic behavior.
frozen_prediction: A fresh-ID exact clone that mechanically displaces one unique general-skill semantic content under the released top_k=6 controller will change final-task success on a fixed ALFWorld panel more than an equally fresh-ID identity placebo whose prompt changes but unique semantic set is unchanged; exact-semantic quotienting of the treatment arm will restore pristine downstream outcomes.
strongest_reduction: The observed effect is only generic prompt/order/duplicate-context perturbation or stochastic decoding noise. The gen_006 identity-placebo controls fresh-ID/prompt perturbation without semantic-set change, and the quotient arm restores the pristine formatted memory prompt byte-for-byte while preserving the same model, tasks and budget.

model.role: author-released SFT warm-start explicitly used by the SkillRL RL-with-SkillBank recipe; do not describe as final RL checkpoint

arms.bank: released + exact-content gen_001 as fresh dyn_001
released + exact-content gen_006 as fresh dyn_006
same as B, but collapse exact semantic_key duplicates while filling exactly six unique general contents; formatted memory prompt must equal A byte-for-byte for every task

execution.memory_injection: author ALFWORLD_TEMPLATE_WITH_MEMORY from step 2; init step has no memory
execution.common_prefix: for each task×seed, generate one shared step-1 response from the identical init prompt, then reset/replay that same projected action into all four arms; branch only from step 2
execution.truth: ALFWorld won/success only; invalid action is recorded from released projection and is not a truth substitute

local_p0_unit: one task × decoding seed, paired across all four arms; 12 tasks × 2 seeds = 24 paired units, 96 arm-episodes

qualification.reason: avoid floor/ceiling; qualification failure is inconclusive, not negative

frozen_metrics.family_replicated_flip_count: number of task families with >=1 B-vs-A success flip across paired units

STOP_FIXED_POLICY_DYNAMIC_BRIDGE.condition: qualified run, B-vs-A is not significant and B-vs-A disagreement is within 0.05 of C-vs-A, with D-vs-A <=0.05; then exact-clone SkillRL downstream propagation is not supported under this local contract

decision.INCONCLUSIVE: qualification/headroom fails, quotient no longer restores pristine prompt, task/seed/arm missing, prompt overflow, runtime drift, or neither GO nor STOP conditions hold

claim_boundary.on_go: supports only C4 fixed-policy downstream representation sensitivity on SkillRL exact-clone subclass; C2 partial-overlap theorem remains separate novelty evidence; C3/SQC method superiority remains locked
claim_boundary.on_stop: does not invalidate C1/C2 STRI; it only rejects this fixed-policy exact-clone downstream bridge
